mapper.insert: insert into cache_invalidation_task(id, patterns, next_attempt_at) values(#{id}, #{patterns}, date_add(now(), interval 10 second))
mapper.select: select id, patterns from cache_invalidation_task where id = #{id}
select id, patterns from cache_invalidation_task where next_attempt_at <= now() order by next_attempt_at, id limit 20
mapper.update: update cache_invalidation_task set attempts = attempts + 1, next_attempt_at = date_add(now(), interval 30 second) where id = #{id}
